1956, August 15
The following is a faithful transcription of a typed draft by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, C. F .M. Cop.
ST. BONAVENTURE MOLASTERY CAPUCEIN FAMILIERS 1740 Mt. Elliott Avenue Detroit 7, Michigan
Feast of the Assumption, August 15th 1956
Blessed be God in all His designs!
Liss Marjorie Franklin 6250 Woodward Detroit, Michigan
God bless you Kiss Marjorie Franklin. God bless you and yours these days - at 6250 Woodward and elsewhere. I hope We the same merciful, good God be with you - each and all - to keep you and guide you during the days and months of trouble and trial that irreligion - worst of all - the avelanche of atheism - determined to push-over on us, on unthinging, ungrateful, unappreciative humanity.
